metadata.scenario: A patient calls upset because the aide who came yesterday didn't follow the care plan. She was supposed to help with bathing and meal prep but only stayed for 30 minutes and left without preparing lunch. The patient is elderly and couldn't make food herself. She wants a different aide assigned.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret, this is Charles Thompson. I'm calling because I'm really upset about the aide who came yesterday. I'm sorry to hear that, Charles. Can you please tell me what happened? Well, she was supposed to help me with bathing and meal prep, but she only stayed for 30 minutes and left without preparing lunch! I couldn’t make food myself. That sounds very frustrating, Charles. I sincerely apologize for this oversight. I really need someone who can follow the care plan properly. Absolutely, I understand. We want to ensure you receive the care you need. Would you like me to assign a different aide for your next visit? Yes, please! I prefer male nurses when possible, too. I can take note of that preference. Let me assure you, we will address this issue right away. Thank you. It's especially important for me to have someone reliable, given my recovery. I completely understand, Charles. I’ll personally ensure your next aide is properly briefed on your care plan. I just really need to feel taken care of during this recovery. Of course, and I'll also follow up with you after the next visit to ensure everything goes smoothly. That would be great, thanks. While I have you on the line, have you considered our meal preparation service as an additional support? I hadn't thought about it, but that sounds helpful. It’s $25 to $30 per hour, and we can match you with someone to handle meal prep regularly. That might be a good idea, especially if I’m struggling. Great! I can set up a care plan for that as well if you'd like. Yes, please do that. Perfect. I’ll arrange for a different aide and start the meal prep service. I’ll follow up with you after the next visit, and I’ll check in on the meal prep schedule as well. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. You’re welcome, Charles. Thank you for your understanding. We’re here for you. Talk to you soon. Talk to you soon. Have a great day!
